archive: unitopia-mudlib.tar.gz (UNItopia MUDlib public release, Universität Stuttgart)
name: UNItopia
english_description: UNItopia, Germany's long-running university LPMud originally centered on the University of Stuttgart campus and the fantasy world of Magyra, featuring the Cathedral of Tadmor (Kathedrale Tadmor), the north bell tower base, the Rathaus steps and foyer signpost, the guild corridor (Gang der Gilden), the player council wing, the Hall of Reincarnation (Halle der Reinkarnation), and the Forum of the Gods.
